Position Purpose: Develops, assess and coordinates holistic care management activities, with primary focus and support towards populations with significant mental/behavioral health needs, to enable quality, cost-effective healthcare outcomes. Evaluates member service needs and develops or contributes to development of care plans/service plans, and educates members, their families and caregivers on services and benefits available to meet member needs.

Key Details: This is a Hybrid position - In Person Member Engagement via home visits and work from home. An active and unrestricted behavioral health professional license based on state contract requirements (e.g., LCSW, LMFT, LMHC, or LPC) for the applicable state upon application submission. Work Schedule: Monday - Friday: 8:00 am - 5:00 pm (CST), NO On Call, Evenings, Weekends or Holidays

Service Delivery Area: Spring, TX and the surrounding counties; Mileage reimbursement is provided for member assessment visits.

• Evaluates the needs of the most complex and high-risk members with mental/behavioral health needs, and recommends a plan of care for the best outcome
• Acts as liaison and member advocate between the member/family, physician, and facilities/agencies
• Supports members with primarily mental/behavioral health needs, such as those with (or a history of) major depression, bipolar disorders, schizophrenia, borderline personality disorder, post-traumatic stress disorder, substance use disorder, self-injurious behavior, psychiatric inpatient admissions, etc
• Performs frequent home and/or other site visits (up to 75% monthly travel for home visits), to assess member needs and collaborate with resources, as required

• Educates on and coordinates community resources, to include medical, behavioral and social services. Provides coordination of service authorization to members and care managers for various services based on service assessment and plans (e.g., meals, employment, housing, foster care, transportation, activities for daily living)

• Maintains accurate documentation and supports the integrity of care management activities in the electronic care management system. Works to ensure compliance with clinical guidelines as well as current state and federal guidelines
• Provides feedback to leadership on opportunities to improve and enhance quality of care and service delivery for long-term care members in a cost-effective manner
• Performs other duties as assigned
• Comply with all policies and standards

Education/Experience: Requires a master’s degree in Mental Health Counseling or Social Work and 2 – 4 years of related experience.

License/Certification:

• An unrestricted behavioral health professional license based on state contract requirements (e.g., LCSW, LMFT, LMHC, or LPC) is required and must be license in the applicable state

Preferred Experience:

• 4+ years of case management experience, preferably within child welfare systems, adoption, foster care, Child Protective Services, pediatric acute care settings or in-patient treatment facilities, schools, or local or state MHA/BHAs for youth
• Experience collaborating with medical and behavioral health providers and managing community resources for Foster Care Medicaid recipients.
• Experience managing high volume caseloads
• Field-based experience strongly preferred
• Strong clinical documentation, problem-solving, communication, attention to detail, organizational, and time management skills required.
• Ability to adapt to changing business needs with openness, flexibility, and professionalism.
• Proficient technology skills and direct experience working within web-based applications and case management systems (i.e. TruCare, Microsoft Office Site – Outlook, M365 Copilot, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, OneNote, etc).
• Must be able to work independently with minimal supervision.
• Experience working in managed care environment is a PLUS (Federal and State Sponsored Govt Programs)
• Bilingual English/Spanish skills are a plus but not required.

NOTE: For Superior Health Plan: Department of Family & Protective Services (DFPS) background check is required.

COMPANY OVERVIEW
KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.
PROGRAMME OVERVIEW
This is an in-person internship based in Dublin, Ireland, commencing in January 2027 for a period of 6 to 9 months. You will work within the technology team as a Software Engineer for the duration of the internship and will attend an orientation providing an overview of KKR and alternative investments. You will contribute to real projects, attend educational and network-building programming, and have the opportunity to showcase your work to technology leaders. Interns are encouraged to leverage KKR's AI tools to accelerate their work, deepen their learning, and contribute fresh perspectives on how emerging technology can enhance the way we operate. Full-time offers may be extended in alignment with exceptional performance, subject to business headcount needs.

This new hub will play a central role in building the world’s first technology platform engineered to manage over one trillion dollars in alternative AUM (assets under management.) Designed from the ground up for scale, security and speed, this is the infrastructure for the future of global finance. Areas of focus include investment technology, portfolio construction and management, liquidity solutions, risk analytics, and advanced data platforms
THE TECHNOLOGY FUNCTION
KKR's Technology organisation is a global group of passionate technologists and product managers, unified by a shared mission to deliver exceptional products and solutions that drive value for our stakeholders, clients, and investors. Our passion for technology and innovation fuels our commitment to creating high-quality, impactful solutions that address complex challenges and meet the evolving needs of our sophisticated businesses.
Teamwork is at the core of the organisation's success. We thrive on open collaboration and continuous learning, driving a culture that values diversity of thought and collective achievement. Our global footprint fosters the integration of a diverse set of ideas and viewpoints in product and solution delivery, allowing us to design more comprehensive solutions that are adaptable and scalable. We optimise for impact, prioritising and delivering solutions with excellence while remaining agile in response to the evolving needs of our businesses.
TEAM YOU WILL BE JOINING — AI, Data, and Platform Technologies (ADAPT)
ADAPT is the foundation of KKR Technology, bringing together its technology pillars — spanning AI and Applied AI, Data and Platform Engineering, Infrastructure, SRE, Technology Experience, and Program Management — to accelerate modernisation, automation, and insight. It delivers secure, scalable, business-aligned platforms and experiences that enable KKR to scale.

Currently attending a university in Ireland, the UK, or continental Europe with an outstanding academic record, and available for a 6–9 month placement starting January 2027
Currently enrolled in a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related technical field (typically undertaking a placement/internship year or a work-integrated master's)
Eligible to work in Ireland on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint for data analysis and communicating ideas
Proficiency with Java, Python, C/C++
Curiosity about and openness to adopting emerging AI technologies in day-to-day workflows
Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy and relevance
Familiarity with effective prompt design and generating reliable results using generative AI tools
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to act both strategically and tactically with exceptional attention to detail
Outstanding time management and organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks with competing deadlines
Team-player who enjoys working in a collaborative and collegial environment and is willing to pitch in when needed

회사 소개
CFS (Coupang Fulfillment Services)는 쿠팡의 물류를 총괄하는 쿠팡의 계열사입니다. CFS 는 물류센터 또는 FC (Fulfillment Center) 운영을 책임지고 있으며, 업무 효율성과 전문성 제고를 통해 글로벌 커머스 기업으로 성장하기 위한 혁신을 이끌어 가고 있습니다.
쿠팡의 FC 는 상품의 입고, 적재, 포장, 출고 및 반품 등 사후 처리에 이르는 다양한 분야의 전문가들이 함께 일하고 있습니다. FC 는 단순한 물류 창고와 다르게 공장 자동화 (Factory Automation) 솔루션과 첨단 기술을 활용하고 있습니다. 제조업 생산 공장과 같이 각각의 업무를 전문화하고, 입고부터 출고까지 데이터를 기반으로 시공간을 효율적으로 관리하여 낭비를 최소화하는 등 최적의 물류 시스템을 구현해 나가고 있습니다.
CFS 는 물류 혁신을 통해 고객이 "쿠팡 없이 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말하는 세상을 만들고자 합니다. 우리의 역동적인 미래를 함께 만들고 싶다면 CFS 와 함께하세요.
직무 소개
Automation Maintenance 팀은 물류센터 내에 구축된 다양한 자동화 설비를 직접 운영·관리하며 안정적인 센터 운영을 지원하는 조직입니다. 상품 분류 설비인 소터(Sorter), 무인 이동 로봇인 자동 유도 차량(Automated Guided Vehicle)과 자율 이동 로봇(Autonomous Mobile Robot), 자동 라벨링 및 패키징 설비, 로봇 암, 컨베이어 등 핵심 자동화 장비의 유지보수와 성능 관리를 담당합니다. 또한 신규 자동화 설비 도입과 지속적인 개선 활동을 통해 현장 근로자의 작업 효율을 높이고 생산성을 극대화합니다. 이를 통해 물류 운영의 안정성과 품질을 강화하며, 쿠팡의 핵심 가치인 고객 만족 실현에 기여합니다.

물류센터 내 자동화 설비의 유지보수 및 예방보전 활동 수행
- 설비 예시: 컨베이어, 자동 분류기(오토소터), 자동 저장 시스템(OSR) 등

- 예시: MTBF(고장 간 평균 시간), MTTR(평균 수리 시간) 등

Indicative - You start the day reviewing the DCR-DCI pipeline — tracking active design change requests, unblocking stalled approvals, and aligning stakeholders on next steps. Mid-morning, you join a cross-regional call to share EU benchmarking findings and pressure-test a proposed standard update. After lunch, you review value-engineering analysis submitted by an external design team, sharpen the data, and prepare a recommendation for sign-off. You close the day updating program documentation and flagging two improvement opportunities identified during a recent site visit. No two days are identical — but every day moves a standard forward.

About the team
Amazon's Global Building Design and Engineering (GBDE) team defines and maintains the physical infrastructure standards behind one of the world's most complex logistics networks. Operating across multiple regions — including North America, Europe, and International (covering markets such as LATAM and India) — GBDE works at the intersection of design, engineering, and program delivery, translating strategic direction into standards that scale across hundreds of facilities globally. The team collaborates closely with construction, operations, and technology partners to ensure standards are rigorous, globally informed, and continuously improved through cross-regional benchmarking and alignment.
